batman-arkham-collection.description: Become Batman across Rocksteady’s Arkham trilogy. Investigate Gotham’s criminal underworld, use gadgets to survey your surroundings, and switch between stealth and free-flow combat.
features: Drive the Batmobile in Arkham Knight

facts.Languages: English, French, German, Italian and Spanish
facts.Activation instructions: Open the Steam desktop app, choose Games → Activate a Product on Steam, and enter your key. Demo keys cannot be redeemed.

requirements: Intel Core i5-750 or AMD Phenom II X4 965
Intel Core i7-3770 or AMD FX-8350

reviews.text: The trilogy shows how the combat and level design evolved. Arkham City was the highlight for me.
The detective missions kept me exploring between story chapters. Some vehicle segments felt repetitive, but the atmosphere held up throughout.
The stealth encounters reward patience and creative gadget use.
A good way to revisit the three campaigns. The maps were fun to explore after the story.
